backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing contact form submission (public), admin-only submission viewing with filtering/sorting, user profile management with role-based access control, and authorization mixin integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the WhatsApp icon SVG path visibility fix in the footer component with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration with details about Sanatani theming, routing, contact information, and admin functionality.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind layers defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes, including Sanatani-inspired warm palette and design tokens for UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title 'KATTAR SANATANI YODHA', root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/public/ads.txt: Empty ads.txt file for advertising configuration.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with eight routes (home, about, programs, philosophy, resources, contact, donate, admin) wrapped in Layout component.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with organization logo, quick links, contact information (email and two phone numbers with clickable links), social media icons (Facebook, X, WhatsApp, YouTube) with explicit text-foreground styling, and attribution with caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image, gradient overlay, organization name, Sanskrit tagline, Hindi mission statement, call-to-action buttons for support and learn more, and animated scroll indicator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper providing consistent Navigation header and Footer across all pages using TanStack Router Outlet.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Mission section displaying four core values (Devotion, Protection, Knowledge, Unity) in a grid with icons, Hindi heading, and description of organizational work.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Navigation component with responsive mobile menu, logo, and dynamic nav links including conditional admin link based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Reusable card component that displays a program with an icon, title, and description with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Displays a grid of four support options (volunteer, spread awareness, contribute skills, share knowledge) with icons and call-to-action links.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, handling identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Hook for managing contact form submission state (submitting, success, error) and calling the backend actor's submitContactForm method.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login, logout, and identity management using DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for fetching admin submissions, checking admin status, and retrieving user profiles from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global styles with Tailwind configuration, custom CSS variables for Sanatani-inspired warm color palette (saffron, terracotta, gold), and font definitions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page with hero section, organization story, and grid of four principles (purpose, vision, values, community) with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx: Admin dashboard page that requires Internet Identity authentication, displays all contact form submissions in a searchable/filterable table, and allows exporting submissions to CSV. Includes admin authorization checks and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a form for submitting messages (name, email, message fields) using the useContactForm hook, plus contact information display with social media links and office details.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donation/support page showcasing multiple ways to contribute, impact areas with percentage breakdowns (cultural programs, education, community service, heritage preservation), and transparency commitments.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Homepage featuring Hero and Mission components, highlights of four key areas (cultural preservation, spiritual education, community building, social service), and call-to-action sections for support and involvement.
frontend/src/pages/Philosophy.tsx: Philosophy page explaining Sanatana Dharma principles including eternal nature (शाश्वत प्रकृति), unwavering commitment (भक्ति योग), and devotional examples from Hindu tradition (Ram, Hanuman, Yudhishthir).
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Programs page displaying six program cards (Vedic study, cultural festivals, youth education, community gatherings, social welfare, heritage preservation) with an impact statistics section showing community reach.
frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx: React component that displays a resources page with hero section, introduction, and four resource categories (Sacred Texts, Video Lectures, Articles & Essays, Downloadable Materials) using Lucide icons and styled cards.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to store, retrieve, and clear parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color palette (including Sanatani-themed colors like saffron and terracotta), typography settings with custom font families (Inter, Cormorant Garamond, Cinzel), extended shadows, and custom animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata file tracking architectural notes, known issues (deployment visibility), and existing features related to fixing WhatsApp icon visibility in the footer.
